title: The Deadly Diamond
subtitle: A Rainy Morning, A Lethal Secret Unfolds
summary: Idle hours and relentless rain leave detective Byomkesh Bakshi restless—until a cryptic piece of news shatters the monotony. When talk of released criminals surfaces, curiosity gives way to a chilling mystery that demands Byomkesh’s legendary insight. What deadly secrets lie behind the headlines, and who will be the next to fall under suspicion?
